title: Decimal Place Value Worksheets: Identify the Digit
intro: Use a place-value chart to distinguish a digit from its value.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Place a decimal in the chart and ask the student to identify the digit in a named place. Include a zero so it is treated as a digit too.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

The three places in 0.406
TenthsHundredthsThousandths
406

0.406 = 4/10 + 0/100 + 6/1000

Ask your student

What value does this digit have in this position?

If your student needs help

If the student names a neighboring digit, read the place names outward from the decimal point together.
